intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. My flagship applications built on one shared House Frontend design system are OpenRO v1.13.0 (single-binary Rust Studio Copilot 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with 11.16 MB binary -41.3% vs v1.1.0, 57.8 KB gzip shell, 37.39ms pinned cold boot -3.8%, 15.72 MB RSS -12.9%, Playable Snapshot Diff & 1-Click Safe Rollback, Luau Dependency Graph Pruner, Studio Economy Simulator, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 MCP tools, 30/30 fuzz, and 3,497 req/s 16w pinned with 5.99ms p95), OpenBell v0.9.0 (Institutional Quant Terminal for Kalshi Trade API v2 with 1-click Full Quant Edge Audit 5-stage Go/No-Go funnel, causal lookahead-canary tests, fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine), and Fleet v1.10.0 (Antigravity-native Swarm Sidebar Plugin with Multi-Worker Broadcast Composer & Filtered Board Export, Swarm Bottleneck Heat Bar & Copy Blocker, Inline Worktree Diff Peek & CWE-22/59 confinement, cog Settings header, 91.1 KiB gz, 112.13ms --jitless boot -18.0%, 1,721 req/s +17.8%, 12.93ms p95 -18.1%, and 30/30 fuzz; legacy standalone Rust v0.12.0 preserved in git), alongside Ergon v0.23.0 (single-binary Rust Claude-Desktop employee desk with 8.79 MB binary -45.1% vs v0.10.0, 8.09ms boot -12.3%, 17.36 MB RSS -12.1%, 5,229.0 req/s +51.1%, 3.41ms p95 -42.4%, Scheduled Routine Catch-Up & SHA-256 Verification Badge, Batch Citation Freshness Gate, Playbook Dry-Run Preview, Verified Playbook Packs, and 31/31 fuzz).
